name: game-network-a1
description: Step A1 of docs/design/game-reconstruction-and-motion.md on an Intel integrated GPU: Ocarina of Time's own anti-aliasing network on Intel's 8x16x16 cooperative matrices (EDEN_NX2_INTEL_COOP_MATRIX=1 in every variant, the suite's baseline 'coop'), then with each switch that cuts the shared-memory traffic around a tensor operation (EDEN_NX2_HMMA_ZERO_C, bit-exact; EDEN_NX2_HMMA_K16_ONCE, which rounds once per K=16) and with both. The network runs in every variant: game presets off, anti-aliasing Game, frame generation off. EDEN_NX2_TENSOR_LOG=1 logs the path each tensor program takes. The cost to compare is the output pass's GPU time in each row's gpu_costs (work, shader 6bd913e1f34e83eb with Max Resolution on). A row counts only when its log has the EDEN_NX2_TENSOR_LOG line for that shader with 8x16x16 matrices and no 'anti-aliasing network bypassed' line. Keep the Max Resolution add-on as it is for every row; run the suite twice in one session and compare the two coop rows before reading any difference.
